questions: Should the difference be absolute difference (always non-negative) or signed difference (positive if guess > score, negative if guess < score)?
Are the scores and guesses guaranteed to be integers, or could they be floats?
What should happen if the input arrays are empty? Return an empty array?
Is the difference computed as |game[i] - guess[i]| or |guess[i] - game[i]|? (order matters for signed difference, not for absolute.)
Can the scores or guesses be negative numbers? If so, does that affect the difference calculation?
Should the output array always contain integers, or could it contain floats if inputs are floats?
Is the function expected to validate that the two arrays are of equal length, or can we assume they are?
What is the maximum length of the arrays or magnitude of values? Are there any constraints on memory or performance?
